$comment: TABLE BIZ-06a (as D30 and D84 amend it): what every install has offline, and what the school licence file changes on a school_lab install. Offline features are never checked: every cell is yes, and no cell may hold a limit, counter or allowance (BIZ-02) or meter local tutoring (BIZ-01). Online features say `subscription` where the online subscription (D70) can switch them on, and `no` where it never can. Prices are TABLE BIZ-18a's (D121), held by the checkout and the cloud gateway, never in the app.
